conviction_note: Baseline median reaction is 9.55% with only 2 of 7 prints up and the last two at -13.4% and -7.7%; I take a moderate negative because this is the first quarter of a second-half price-versus-cost recovery that management promised on 2026-06-04 with explicit conditions attached, and the corpus contains nothing showing those conditions were met while the stock drifted 10.1% lower into the print.

findings.finding: At the last print Quanex reported GAAP EPS of $0.07, down 84.1% year on year, on revenue of $462.4m up only 2.19%, and committed to 'recover price versus cost imbalance shortfall during the second half of the year, ASSUMING normal seasonality and subsiding inflation, while prioritizing debt repayment and opportunistic share repurchases' - so this release is the first of the two quarters that promise depends on, and the stock fell 13.42% on the day the promise was made.
findings.why_not_priced: The guide is wire copy; what is not aggregated is that it is explicitly conditional on two macro variables and that this print is the first observation of it. There is no news-search coverage of this ticker at all (n_queries=0 in every sweep) and the entire non-filing corpus is a single Stocktwits thread with two messages in the eleven weeks before the print, so nobody in the observed corpus has checked the conditions. An 84% EPS decline on flat revenue is a margin problem, and margin problems in building products do not resolve in one quarter.
findings.independence: A second corpus item from an independent analytic source on the same day frames the same risk - 'downside fades if inflation subsides, second-half price/cost recovery lands, and normal seasonality returns', i.e. three conditions rather than one - https://clawpool.hihired.org/newsimpact/?ticker=NX&utm_source=stocktwits&utm_medium=parent_url

searched_and_found_nothing: the content of the 8-K with items 7.01 and 9.01 filed 2026-08-27, seven days before the print - no body is stored; I note that the identical pattern occurred on 2026-05-28, seven days before the June print, which makes it look like a routine investor-presentation posting rather than a signal, and I did not build on it
any 8-K item 5.02, 1.01, 2.02 pre-announcement or 8.01 in the window
any 13D or activist position; the newest holder filing is a passive 13G dated 2026-04-30
any read on the five Form 4s dated 2026-08-31 - no bodies are stored and Quanex's fiscal year ends in October, so the timing does not obviously correspond to an annual grant
any news-wire coverage, consensus estimate or housing/window-shipment channel data for this print; the only broker footprint is two undated Sidoti research mentions from May and June
any evidence on whether the inflation and seasonality conditions in the guide were met
baseline_tension: It agrees with the run-in (-4.7% over five sessions, -10.1% over twenty) and with the reaction history (2 of 7 up), which means it is largely confirmatory rather than contrarian and cannot be worth much on its own - hence a number well inside the 9.55% median.
corpus_limits: No option chain, so no implied move or skew. No news search was run for this ticker; only one document body exists and it contains just two messages after 2026-06-08, so the eleven weeks of run-in are effectively unobserved. No 8-K or Form 4 body is stored. This is an after-the-close print, so the 2026-09-03 sweep and price bar are pre-event and admissible; no item in this capture carried a non-empty tripwire_tells.
